name: Sanada Yukimura
contribution: A Japanese samurai warrior of the Sengoku period.

checks.lead: Sanada Nobushige (真田 信繁; 1567 – June 3, 1615), also known as Sanada Yukimura (真田 幸村), was a Japanese samurai warrior of the Sengoku period. He was especially known as the leading general on the defending side of the Siege of Osaka.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
